entries.title: Psalms 135:6
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Seas - In the visible seas, and in the invisible depths both of the earth and of the waters.

entries.title: Psalms 135:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: From - From all parts of the earth, from one end to another. Rain - An eminent instance of his good providence.

entries.title: Psalms 135:14
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Judge - Will in due time plead the cause of his people. Repent - He will recall that severe sentence which for their sins he had passed upon them.
